notes.title: Time Records and Progress Reset Added!
notes.content:
Each level now records your best completion time. Push yourself to beat your previous records and show off your speedrunning skills.
Added the option to reset game progress and records. Whether you want to start from scratch or just improve your times, the choice is yours.
